pending_diagnosis: DIAGNOSIS: Anti-NMDA Receptor Encephalitis (secondary to an ovarian teratoma) THE SMOKING GUN: The extreme delta brush pattern on continuous EEG accompanied by classic oro-facial dyskinesias and profound autonomic instability in a previously healthy young female. PATHOPHYSIOLOGY: Ectopic neural tissue expressed within an occult ovarian teratoma breaks immune tolerance, generating IgG autoantibodies directed against the GluN1 subunit of NMDA receptors. These antibodies cross-link and cause selective internalization and loss of NMDA receptors from synaptic membranes throughout the forebrain and limbic systems, leading to severe dopaminergic disinhibition, psychosis, movement disorders, autonomic storms, and hypoventilation.
